report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis: all sampled checkout traces return HTTP 200 across order, inventory, payment, and postgres spans, and order metrics show only 200 responses with no 502s. The sole deployment record is a baseline v1.0.0 with no previous version, so it cannot establish a deployment-caused fault. No current evidence substantiates a bounded root cause; logs were excluded and error evidence is absent, so hand off for human investigation.
missing_evidence: Logs for order service (ev-56f9150e5abcd594-r0-order_logs) were excluded from context; needed to confirm or refute checkout error signatures.
No telemetry shows checkout errors: traces show all /v1/checkout spans returning 200; need evidence of actual error rate/status codes.
Deployment record only shows baseline order v1.0.0 with no previous version; need a faulty deployment record (version change) to test the operator hypothesis.
Metrics show order v2.0.0 with zero traffic and v1.0.0 serving 200s; need confirmation of which version is intended/active and any 5xx counts.
